Intensity-adaptive agglomerative clustering grouper

Source: R/clustering.R
iaac_grouper.Rd

Agglomerative 1-D clustering where each centroid's m/z uncertainty depends on its intensity: sigma_i = mz_i * p0 * max(1, sqrt(Isat / I_i)) / 1e6. A group is kept only if every merge inside it is within k sigma. Uses mz and intensity. See fast_1D_iaac_grouping_cpp().

Usage

iaac_grouper(k = 1, p0 = 8, Isat = 1e+05)

Arguments

k

Merge threshold in sigma. k < 0 gives all singletons, Inf one group.

p0

Mass accuracy floor (ppm) reached at high intensity.

Isat

Intensity at which the uncertainty reaches p0.

Value

A grouper closure - see grouper-contract.

See also

ppm_upgma(), abs_upgma(), pelt_grouper(), validate_grouper()

Examples

g <- iaac_grouper(k = 1, p0 = 8, Isat = 1e5)
g(c(100.0, 100.001, 200.0), intensity = c(1000, 800, 200))
#> [1] 1 1 3
